facts.project_name: UCONN Holcomb & Whitney Residence Halls — Connector Walkway Repairs
facts.notes: CD-level estimate from a 6-sheet CD Review set (09/21/26); masonry repair and roof replacement at two one-story brick connector bridges plus two chimneys. State of Connecticut project (UCONN).

deliverables.name: CD-Level Cost Estimate — Connector Walkway & Chimney Repairs
deliverables.description: Trade-based CD-level construction cost estimate from the CD Review set: masonry restoration, roofing replacement, recommended concrete/handrail/painting items, access and general conditions at CT prevailing wage; draft issue with basis of estimate, one review call, one comment round, final issue.
deliverables.source_language: Please provide a cost estimate proposal for the attached project

deliverables.name: Optional Site Visit — Storrs, CT
deliverables.description: One site visit to Storrs, CT to field-verify repair extents and access conditions, offered as an optional add-alternate.

gaps.question: No specifications accompany the CD Review set; repair methods and materials are keynoted only.
gaps.why_it_matters: Unit rates for restoration work depend on method (e.g., cutting depth, mortar type, cap material).
gaps.proposed_assumption: The estimate is based solely on the six-sheet CD Review set dated 09/21/26 (CS101, A101, A102, A201, A202, A203); no specifications or photographs have been provided. Repair methods and materials are priced per the keynotes and industry-standard practice for matching existing construction.
gaps.pricing_basis: 6-sheet CD Review set only; no specifications or photographs

gaps.question: Most repair areas (repointing, spalling, cracks) are keynoted by location but not dimensioned.
gaps.why_it_matters: Masonry repair quantity is the estimate; it is condition-dependent.
gaps.proposed_assumption: Quantities are measured from the 1/4-inch plans and elevations where dimensioned and otherwise quantified from the keynoted locations and extents on the drawings; unit rates (per SF of repointing, per brick, per LF of cap) are shown so the Owner can adjust quantities if field conditions differ.
gaps.pricing_basis: Measured quantities with visible unit rates; keynoted extents where undimensioned

gaps.question: Hidden deterioration behind caps, flashing, and at the chimneys cannot be seen until work starts.
gaps.why_it_matters: Restoration projects routinely grow once masonry is opened.
gaps.proposed_assumption: A separately identified unforeseen-conditions allowance is carried on the masonry and roofing scope in addition to design contingency.
gaps.pricing_basis: Identified unforeseen-conditions allowance plus design contingency

gaps.question: The work is for the University of Connecticut, a State of Connecticut agency.
gaps.why_it_matters: Prevailing wage materially raises labor-intensive restoration rates.
gaps.proposed_assumption: All trades are priced at Connecticut prevailing wage rates for the Storrs locality.

gaps.question: Scaffolding, lift, and roof-access requirements at the bridges and the Whitney Hall chimneys (slate roof) are not shown.
gaps.why_it_matters: Access can equal the repair cost on small masonry jobs.
gaps.proposed_assumption: Pipe scaffolding or lifts at both bridges and roof-level staging with slate protection at both chimneys are carried in general conditions; no interior building access is assumed.
gaps.pricing_basis: Scaffolding/lift and chimney staging allowance in general conditions

gaps.question: Construction timing relative to the academic calendar is not stated.
gaps.why_it_matters: Occupied residence halls can force off-hours or summer-only work.
gaps.proposed_assumption: Work is assumed during a campus break or coordinated with Residential Life during normal hours; no premium time is carried unless directed.
gaps.pricing_basis: Normal working hours; no premium time

gaps.question: Several keynotes are marked 'recommend' (handrail post replacement to current code, step and sidewalk repairs, door trim painting).
gaps.why_it_matters: The Owner may elect to include or exclude them.
gaps.proposed_assumption: Recommended items are priced as separately identified lines so they can be added to or removed from the base scope.

gaps.question: The replacement roof membrane system and insulation are not specified.
gaps.why_it_matters: Single-ply versus modified bitumen and tapered insulation change the roofing cost materially.
gaps.proposed_assumption: A fully adhered single-ply or modified bitumen membrane on tapered insulation to achieve pitch to the existing scuppers, with new flashing and counterflashing at the parapets, is assumed; the system will be confirmed with the architect at kickoff.
gaps.pricing_basis: Membrane on tapered insulation with new flashing; system to be confirmed

gaps.question: No hazardous materials survey was provided for the existing roofing, flashing, and sealants.
gaps.why_it_matters: Asbestos-containing roofing or caulk changes demolition cost.
gaps.proposed_assumption: An abatement allowance is carried as a separately identified line; survey and abatement design are excluded.

gaps.question: No photographs or site visit were provided or requested.
gaps.why_it_matters: Field verification tightens condition-dependent quantities but adds travel.
gaps.proposed_assumption: The base fee is prepared from the drawings only; one site visit to Storrs to field-verify repair extents is offered as an optional add-alternate, priced separately, with mileage billed at cost.
gaps.pricing_basis: Base from drawings only; site visit optional

gaps.question: The number of review and revision rounds is not stated.
gaps.why_it_matters: Re-pricing a revised set is additional effort.
gaps.proposed_assumption: One review call with the architect and one consolidated round of comments are included in the final issue; re-pricing of revised or permit-set drawings will be billed at the hourly rates herein.
gaps.pricing_basis: One review call and one revision cycle

gaps.question: Construction start, GC procurement, and soft-cost scope are not stated.
gaps.why_it_matters: The summary must separate construction cost from Owner costs.
gaps.proposed_assumption: The estimate is in current dollars with escalation to an assumed construction midpoint approximately nine months out shown separately; general conditions, contractor overhead and profit, bonds and insurance, and contingency are shown as separate identified lines; soft costs, design fees, permits, and Owner costs are excluded.
gaps.pricing_basis: Hard construction cost; markups and escalation as identified lines

exclusions_suggested: Reconciliation with a Construction Manager or bidder (available as an additional service)
Estimating lengthy or significant design revisions after receipt of documents and notice to proceed
Hazardous materials survey and abatement design
Structural investigation of the bridge arches, parapets, or chimneys
Soft costs, design fees, permits, testing, and Owner costs
Life cycle cost analysis / OPEX costing
Bid-phase services, including bid leveling and addenda pricing (available as an additional service)
Additional estimates or milestones beyond those listed (e.g., re-pricing of the permit or bid set)
Reimbursables, including mileage for the optional site visit (billed at cost with no markup, if incurred)
